policy.notice: This catalog describes compatibility claims. Only a compiled model plugin can expose a runtime operation.

controller.transport: Linux hwmon with guarded direct Super I/O fallback

known_conflicts: The vendor /proc/it86 interface or ug_it86x_cpufan module must not access the controller concurrently.
Direct fallback is available only after the it87 module is unloaded and requires --force --apply.
Wake-on-LAN follows the stock eth0/eth1 map and requires --force --apply until it is physically validated.

evidence.method: Clean-room observation of the vendor module interface and validation of the IT8613 identity/access sequence.
evidence.scope: CPU and system fan PWM/status; AC recovery startup policy; stock hwmonitor-480t magic-packet WOL on eth0 and eth1.

controller.transport: Linux hwmon with guarded direct Super I/O fallback

known_conflicts: The vendor /proc/it86 interface or ug_it86x_sio module must not access the controller concurrently.
The generic it87 driver may remain loaded while its name=it8613 hwmon node is used; it must be unloaded before direct fallback.

evidence.method: Static clean-room reverse engineering of ug_it86x-sio.ko plus the DXP4800S branch in ug-load-drive.sh and hwmonitor.
evidence.scope: Exact DMI branch; IT8613 identity/access sequence; single sysfan1 tachometer and PWM path; AC recovery registers; stock user-space automatic fan policy; generic hwmonitor magic-packet WOL on eth0 and eth1. No physical write validation.

write_requirements: --apply for hwmon writes; --force --apply for direct fallback writes
exact DMI product name DXP480T Plus

controller.transport: Linux hwmon with guarded direct Super I/O fallback

known_conflicts: The vendor /proc/it86 interface or ug_it86x_cpufan module must not access the controller concurrently.
Direct fallback is available only after the it87 module is unloaded and requires --force --apply.

evidence.method: Static clean-room reverse engineering of the DXP480T Plus branch in ug_it86x-cpufan.ko.
evidence.scope: Three tachometer paths; the stock DXP480T Plus shared CPU/all-fans PWM branch at 0x17/0x73; AC recovery path; hwmonitor-480t magic-packet WOL on eth0 and eth1. The stock module does not provide a sysfan2-specific direct PWM write map.

evidence.method: Physical DXP480T Plus validation reported by the LLLED_FPK project user on 2026-07-18.
evidence.scope: The previous direct all-fans implementation failed at its unverified sysfan2 control register after updating CPU. The fallback now follows the firmware-proven shared 0x17/0x73 CPU/all command path and awaits physical all-fans validation.
N76E003 I2C/SMBus LED MCU identified; no LED write protocol exposed.

write_requirements: IT8613 identity check for fan and AC-recovery operations
vendor /proc/it86 driver must be inactive for direct fan fallback
magic-packet Wake-on-LAN support on firmware-mapped eth0 and eth1

controller.transport: Linux hwmon with guarded direct Super I/O fallback; Linux ethtool for WOL

known_conflicts: The vendor /proc/it86 interface or ug_it86x_sio module must not access the Super I/O controller concurrently.
The generic it87 driver may remain loaded while its name=it8613 hwmon node is used; it must be unloaded before direct fan fallback.
The firmware only establishes eth0 and eth1 for WOL; renamed interface mappings are not guessed.

evidence.method: Static clean-room reverse engineering of the exact DXP4800 route in ug-load-drive.sh, ug_it86x-sio.ko, and hwmonitor-amd.
evidence.scope: One system-fan IT8613 path; AC-recovery registers; magic-packet WOL on eth0 and eth1. No physical write validation.

write_requirements: exact DMI product name DXP6800 Pro

controller.transport: Linux hwmon with guarded direct Super I/O fallback

known_conflicts: The vendor /proc/it86 interface or ug_it86x_cpufan module must not access the controller concurrently.
The generic it87 driver may remain loaded while its name=it8613 hwmon node is used; it must be unloaded before direct fallback.

evidence.method: Static clean-room reverse engineering of the DXP6800 branch in ug_it86x-cpufan.ko and its stock DMI routing.
evidence.scope: Three tachometer paths; CPU PWM at 0x16/0x6b; the stock paired system PWM transaction at 0x17/0x73 then 0x1e/0x7b; AC recovery registers 0xf2/0xf4; hwmonitor-480t magic-packet WOL on eth0 and eth1. No physical write validation.
